source_text: Οὐκοῦν ὃς μὴ ἅγιος ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ εἰ μὴ προαγνίζοιτο, καθ' ὃν ἂν πρέπει τρόπον, ἀποχωρείτω μακράν· νηποινὶ γὰρ οὐχὶ τῶν θείων ἅψεται θυσιαστηρίων.
pass_a_gloss: …hos mē hagios en Christō… thysiastēriōn… doxa… Amēn.
pass_b_english: Cyril: So then who is not holy in Christ and if he should not pre-purify, according to whichever manner would be fitting, let him depart far; for not without-penalty will he touch the divine altars.
Palladius: You have spoken most uprightly.
Cyril: To God the glory unto the ages, Amen.

choices.why: Must be holy in Christ first.

anf_compare.notes: No PD complete English of Cyril De adoratione Book 11. Sense from PG 68 Greek lock. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.
